project.name: participant-dedup
project.identity: A Google Sheets review tool that finds likely duplicate participant rows, explains the match, and applies reviewer-approved deletions atomically on a copy with an audit trail.
project.audience: Operators cleaning participant sheets who need reviewer control and recoverable audit evidence rather than silent fuzzy deletion.
project.core_loop: Read a copied sheet, detect likely duplicate rows, present evidence for review, apply only approved changes atomically, and retain the audit record for reconciliation.
project.north_star: Duplicate participant rows are removed with high-confidence evidence and human review while the source data remains protected and recoverable.
not_this: An automatic deletion bot against source data
A fuzzy match that hides ambiguity or stores participant data in the repository

mvp.definition: A copied Google Sheet can be scanned for likely duplicates, reviewed, and updated with an atomic, auditable operation.

complete_product.definition: The tool reliably supports bounded duplicate review, configurable matching evidence, safe copy-based application, audit reconciliation, and operator recovery for supported sheets.

outcomes.name: Likely duplicate pairs are presented with match evidence and remain pending until a reviewer decides.

layers.intended: The operator decides whether a fuzzy match is a duplicate.
layers.planned: The README defines a reviewer-first duplicate workflow.
layers.implemented: The Apps Script tool detects likely duplicates and supports reviewer-approved application.
layers.verified: Repository documentation supports the workflow; no live sheet UAT was run here.

evidence.note: Defines fuzzy detection, reviewer decision, and atomic audit behavior.

blockers.summary: Live Google Sheets authorization, representative data, and operator UAT are required to verify matching and recovery behavior.

outcomes.name: Approved changes apply atomically to a copy and leave an audit trail without persisting participant data in the repository.

layers.intended: The source sheet and participant privacy remain protected during cleanup.
layers.planned: Copy-only operation and audit requirements are explicit.
layers.implemented: The repository contains the documented Apps Script application path.
layers.verified: No live operation or audit reconciliation was executed in this bootstrap.

evidence.note: Documents copy-only application and no participant data in the repository.

blockers.summary: A live copy-based run is needed to verify atomicity, audit completeness, and rollback expectations.

verified.note: Documented claims only; no live sheet UAT was performed.

drift.summary: The review and copy-only safety outcome is documented but blocked on authenticated live-sheet UAT with representative data and audit reconciliation.

evidence.note: Defines the required external UAT boundary.
